en.monde.002: No building in range: get close to a ruin or a church.
en.monde.003: The crew takes shelter and barricades the building for the night.
en.monde.004: Night falls. Behind the walls, the convoy is safe.
en.monde.005: Night falls. Take shelter in a building: prowlers are coming out.
en.monde.011: A traveller is waiting by the roadside.
en.meteo.001: Sandstorm in %d s: a wall of sand is approaching. Take shelter.
en.meteo.003: The sandstorm is dying down. Hit the road once the crew has boarded again.
en.atelier.002: %d metal needed for the armour plates.
en.atelier.008: Engines rumble in the distance. You are no longer alone on the road.
en.mines.001: Minefield at %d m. The convoy stops before entering it.
en.mines.002: The flail is out of order.
en.mines.004: Blind crossing: every mine hit is a disaster.
en.mines.005: Minefield cleared: the road is open.
en.mines.006: Mine clearing interrupted: nothing left to detonate the mines.
en.mines.007: A mine is defused and recovered.
en.mines.008: The dog is killed by an explosion. It will not be seen again.
en.mines.009: The dog is wounded by shrapnel.
en.abordage.003: %s: the explosive lance went off against the vehicle.
en.tir.001: Out of ammo: salvage some from the wrecks.
en.tir.004: %s: a soldier has fallen at his seat.
en.tir.005: %s: a crew member is out of action.
en.tir.007: A survivor is out of action in %s.
en.tir.010: The crew of %s is out of action: the vehicle is lost.
en.tir.015: %s: no spare part and not enough metal for %s.
en.modele.001: A crate of parts by the roadside. Assemble the motorbike.
en.modele.002: Creative mode: all parts, no limit. Tap a vehicle, then "Grid".
en.modele.003: The Berliet and its crew take to the no man's land road again.
en.modele.004: Can't repair while moving: order a halt.
en.modele.005: No mechanic in range: bring the convoy closer.
en.modele.007: Those who wander off are never seen again.
en.modele.008: Stop the convoy to change assignments.
en.modele.012: Can't U-turn: enemies are too close.
en.modele.013: Take the vehicles out of the garage before turning around.
en.modele.014: U-turn: the convoy heads back the other way.
en.modele.015: Out %s: the crew is weakening. Buy some in town or find some on the road.
en.modele.018: You can't abandon the last vehicle.
en.modele.019: The %s is the expedition's truck: it can't be abandoned.
en.modele.020: %s abandoned: its parts can be salvaged.
en.modele.021: The convoy is wiped out. Distance travelled: %d m.
en.modele.023: The soldiers of %s climb back into their vehicle.
en.modele.025: A trailer is in front: put a motorised vehicle ahead of it.
en.modele.027: Soldiers are on the ground: they are getting back to their vehicles.
en.modele.028: A vehicle has no crew left: re-embark it before moving on.
en.modele.029: A traveller is speaking to you.
en.modele.030: A vehicle is in the garage: take it out before moving on.
en.modele.031: A vehicle is camouflaged: uncover it before moving on.
en.modele.033: A vehicle is immobilised: repair it or abandon it.
en.modele.035: Minefield ahead: clear it, turn back or drive through.
en.choc.001: Driving: ram anything blocking the road.
en.choc.002: Driving: avoid, overtake and pass in the other lane.
en.choc.003: %s swerves into the other lane and dodges the crash!
en.choc.007: %s tries to get around us in the other lane!
en.choc.008: %s got behind us: it is harassing the convoy!
en.voie.002: %s rams our flank: %s takes the hit!
en.voie.003: %s knocks the %s bike into the ditch!
en.voie.004: Obstacle on the road: the convoy backs up, then goes around by the next lane.
en.voie.005: Obstacle on the road: no free lane to go around it.
en.voie.006: The main truck is out of action: repair it on the spot.
en.annonce.ville_d: %d m away · the convoy will slow down
en.annonce.ville_pillee: %d m away · town looted, be careful
en.abordage.004: %s: a raider is thrown off the deck!
en.formation.001: Contact! The convoy forms up for battle: escorts cover the truck's flanks.
en.formation.002: No threat in range: the convoy resumes its column.
en.aide.001: Tap a vehicle to select it. Drag its card left or right to change its place in the convoy.
en.aide.002: The map shows the roads open from your town. Pick a neighbouring town, then Leave. Rings go from green (calm) to red (dangerous).
en.aide.003: Halt: the crew gets out, sets up camp and repairs. A night at the bivouac makes the night pass faster.
en.aide.004: In town: talk to the mayor, get repairs, haggle. The exit gate picks your next road.
en.aide.005: Mayor's mission: the cargo is on your truck. Deliver it without losing it. Success makes the town friendly, failure upsets it.
en.aide.006: Your reputation changed. It decides the welcome, prices, missions and camps you will meet. See the map.
en.aide.007: Enemies in sight! Each vehicle fights on its own. Set fire orders and repair between alerts.
en.aide.008: Crash! The Driving order decides: avoid and overtake, or ram. The Berliet's front blades absorb the impact.
en.monde.020: Passed through %s without stopping, heading for %s.
en.route.001: A %s convoy passes you in the other lane. You wave.
en.route.002: An armed %s convoy is coming head-on, lights out!
en.route.003: The %s convoy hands you %d L of %s as it passes.
en.route.004: The %s convoy passed without a word.
en.rumeur.001: They say the road to %s is quiet, mostly merchants.
en.rumeur.002: In %s, people sleep with the door open, apparently.
en.rumeur.003: An old man swears the road to %s never gave him trouble.
en.rumeur.004: A few prowlers on the road to %s, nothing serious.
en.rumeur.005: Convoys to %s are driving a bit faster than usual.
en.rumeur.006: A driver back from %s had a jerrycan stolen, nothing more.
en.rumeur.007: Raiders have settled on the road to %s: people go in groups.
en.rumeur.008: In %s, shutters close as soon as daylight fades.
en.rumeur.009: Two convoys vanished toward %s last month.
en.rumeur.010: Nobody comes back from the road to %s without a wreck to talk about.
en.rumeur.011: Nobody dares say the name of %s out loud anymore.
en.rumeur.012: Maps end before %s: beyond that, every man for himself.
en.rumeur.013: You're not quite at home here: people look at you sideways.
en.rumeur.014: Others make the rules here, and they dislike strangers.
en.rumeur.015: The land changes: emptier roads, harder looks.
en.modele.037: The road is blocked by an enemy vehicle.
en.modele.038: Vehicles are catching up from behind!
en.ville.002: Black smoke over %s. The gates have been smashed open.
en.ville.003: The walls of %s in sight. The convoy will slow down at the gate.
en.ville.004: The guards of %s open the main gate.
en.ville.005: The Berliet is pushed onto a freight lift. The chains creak.
en.ville.006: The Baron has fallen. His men open the tanks: fuel, ammo and metal for the convoy.
en.ville.008: The convoy has left %s. Safe travels.
en.ville.009: "Open the arena!" The Baron of Brut and his guard charge the convoy.
en.ville.010: %s is marked on the map. Respawn point.
en.ville.011: %s is burning. Bodies in the streets, survivors calling for help.
en.ville.012: Welcome to %s. The convoy is sheltered behind the walls.
en.ville.015: The convoy heads for the exit gate.
en.ville.017: The convoy is parked in %s: ask to depart and choose your exit.
en.ville.018: The convoy sets off toward the exit.
en.ville.020: The mechanic has put the convoy back in shape (%d metal).
en.ville.024: Receipts shown: %d. Deposits in other towns lose %d %%.
en.mission.004: On the way! The convoy speeds through %s.
en.mission.005: The raiders' convoy is in sight, %d m ahead. Catch it!
en.mission.007: The raiders have vanished into the no man's land.
en.vue_interface.006: Mr. %s, mayor of %s, unfolds a map on his desk. "I have work for a convoy like yours. Take your pick."
en.vue_interface.009: "Leave the convoy with me, I'll give it back as good as new." Price: %d metal.
en.vue_interface.010: "Nothing to fix on your vehicles. Come back when things get rough."
en.vue_interface.012: The welding stations and the gantry crane are yours: transform your vehicles on the grid.
en.vue_interface.014: Which gate to leave by? The road beyond leads to the chosen sector.
en.vue_interface.016: Several hundred souls behind sheet-metal walls. No storms and no raiders here: the convoy is safe.
en.vue_interface.017: No building in range: the vehicles camouflage in place.
en.vue_interface.024:
NIGHT FALLS: prowlers are coming out.
%s
en.vue_interface.027: The sentries let you in. You can trade, repair or rest.
en.vue_interface.030: Heading for %s: %d m of quiet road
en.vue_interface.035:
Convoy wiped out
Distance: %d m   Enemies destroyed: %d

Those who wander off are never seen again.
en.terrain.001: No hangar or barn in range with a free spot.
en.terrain.002: %s goes into %s: sheltered and being repaired.
en.terrain.005: No building in range for shelter (ruin, farm, church...).
en.terrain.007: The crew of %s returns to its vehicle.
en.terrain.008: %d survivor(s) take position in %s and wait for the enemy.
en.terrain.010: %s is being camouflaged under nets and branches...
en.terrain.013: %d mines laid on the road ahead of the convoy: do not cross them.
en.camp.001: A camp is already set up.
en.camp.002: Can't set up camp with enemies in sight.
en.camp.003: %s: camp set up, %d min of work. Defend it.
en.camp.004: Work interrupted: the vehicle stays immobilised.
en.camp.005: Attack on the camp! %d enemy vehicle(s).
en.camp.006: %s: repair complete, the convoy can move on.
en.camp.008: Halt: the crew dismounts and sets up camp. Gunners stay at their posts.
en.camp.009: Halt: everyone on alert, mechanics are repairing.
en.camp.011: Camp is up: tents pitched, fire lit.
en.camp.012: Scouts only leave during a halt.
en.camp.013: Two scouts set out on foot to survey the sector.
en.camp.014: Stop the convoy to make a stash.
en.camp.015: Not enough supplies for this stash.
en.camp.017: The stash has been looted: nothing is left.
en.monde.006a: The survivors have recovered their strength.
en.nuit.aucun: No shelter in sight: look for a ruin or a church.
en.phys.enlise: %s is bogged down: wheels spinning, the crew will dig it out.
en.phys.degage: %s is free and moves off slowly.
en.phys.crevaison: Flat tyre on %s: the crew is changing the wheel.
en.trans.collision: Crash: %s hits the obstacle before it could stop.
en.trans.glisse: The convoy slides under braking: soft or slippery ground.
en.trans.tamponne: %s rams %s: the convoy closed up too fast.
en.trans.saut: The convoy takes off over a bump!
en.trans.atterrit: Hard landing: crews shaken, suspensions strained.
en.trans.bascule_av: %s noses over under braking and slams back down: centre of gravity too high.
en.trans.bascule_ar: %s rears up under acceleration and slams back down: centre of gravity too high.
en.trans.renverse: %s rolls over in the turn: U-turn taken too fast.
en.trans.derape: U-turn at speed: the convoy skids.
en.ui.bandeau_pause: PAUSED: orders can still be given
en.ui.embuscade_prete: Ambush set: the enemy cannot see you. The first volley will take them by surprise.
en.ui.tempete_annonce: SANDSTORM in %d s: accuracy and speed reduced.
en.ui.tempete_en_cours: SANDSTORM (%d s left): accuracy halved, speed reduced, open vehicles worn down.

en.ville.faire_cache: Make a cache (a quarter of the supplies)

en.mission.proposition:
“I have %s that must reach %s. It's a single stage, %d m through the %s, no detours.

On the road, people tell me of %s.%s %s

I'm giving you men: %s. Deliver it all to %s and the mayor there will pay you: %s.”
en.mission.berliet_hs: The Berliet is out of action: the cargo will not reach %s.
en.mission.livree:
“%s! We've been expecting you since dawn.” The mayor of %s hands you: %s.

The men from %s stay here; you never see again those who go away.
en.mission.reprises_texte: The raiders' convoy is destroyed. You recover the supplies of %s: %s.
en.mission.perdus_texte: The raiders' convoy has vanished into no man's land with the supplies of %s.
en.mission.demi_tour: You turned back: the cargo will not reach %s.
en.ville.maire_rien:
Mr %s, mayor of %s, receives you in his office, beneath the yellowed portrait of a president nobody remembers any more.

“Here, the gate opens to anyone who doesn't shoot. Stay as long as you need. As for work, come back later: I have nothing for you today.”
